intentions.title: Continuously mirror a remote Barkpark dataset into a local workspace via a resumable SSE pull, so a local install stays live-synced without polling
intentions.evidence: worker.ex opens a streaming Req.get to GET /v1/data/listen/:dataset, resumes via Last-Event-ID sourced from Cursor.get, reconnects with capped exponential backoff + jitter (floor 1s/cap 30s) on stream end/error, and uses a dedicated Finch pool so the endless stream can't starve the webhook dispatcher.

intentions.title: Push local mutations back to the remote as a CAS-safe replay, so a cloned/edited workspace can round-trip changes without clobbering the source of truth
intentions.evidence: pusher.ex drain/3 walks Outbox events id ASC, routes task.* events through claim/close endpoints and others through push_fun, records PushDocRev (remote rev priming) and PushConflict on rejection, and only advances PushCursor after a durable write (write-then-advance).

intentions.title: Never let pull and push cursors, or sync-originated and locally-originated events, cross-contaminate — prevent ping-pong/echo amplification between two Barkparks
intentions.evidence: push_cursor.ex moduledoc: pull tracks remote Last-Event-ID, push tracks local mutation_events.id, 'mixing them would let one rewind the other'; outbox.ex excludes source="sync" rows from the push feed; applier.ex prime_push_ledger primes PushDocRev with the remote rev on apply so a later local edit doesn't spuriously conflict.

intentions.title: Guarantee sync writes always land in a resolvable, correctly-scoped local workspace — never a NULL/global write
intentions.evidence: applier.ex apply_event/2 refuses to write and logs a warning when ctx.scope == :unresolved; settings.ex requires workspace present for `enabled`; worker.ex listen_url builds a workspace/project-scoped path and schedule_reconnect/2 gives unresolved-workspace errors a long fixed 300s backoff (config error, not a flaky link) instead of storming reconnects.

intentions.title: Make sync default-off and independently gated (pull vs push) so a fresh install boots inert and each direction is opt-in
intentions.evidence: settings.ex: config.exs default enabled:false; `enabled` requires full creds (url/token/dataset/workspace) AND the flag; `push_active?/1` is a separate AND of enabled and push_enabled, so push can be off while pull is on, or vice versa; PushCursor.bootstrap_if_absent skips pre-enablement history so first-enable never replays a backlog.

intentions.title: Treat failed events as durably quarantined, not silently dropped or endlessly retried — dead-letter after max attempts, record conflicts on CAS rejection
intentions.evidence: applier.ex apply_event/2 calls DeadLetter.record_failure/mark_dead and advances the cursor past a dead-lettered event only after the durable DL write; push_conflict.ex records the losing local_document on INSERT only and never overwrites it on re-record; pusher.ex halts the drain (cursor not advanced) on {:error, :transient} so the next tick replays from the same event.
